marketing.title: Slotwise
marketing.description: Timetables, rescheduling and exam seating for colleges.
marketing.heroTitle: Clash-free timetables for your college, in an afternoon
marketing.heroBody: Start from the Excel sheets you already have. Slotwise builds the timetable, moves classes around holidays and fests, and plans exam seating. Students and faculty see it on their phones.

timetable.title: Timetable in one click
timetable.body: No section, teacher or room is ever double-booked. Labs get consecutive periods. Drag to adjust; clashes are explained in plain words.

reschedule.title: Holidays and events
reschedule.body: Add a holiday or a fest and Slotwise finds make-up periods that suit the section, the teacher and a free room.

exams.title: Exam seating
exams.body: Seating plans where no two students with the same paper sit side by side, plus fair invigilation duties.

phones.title: On every phone
phones.body: Students and faculty see today's classes, changes and their exam seat in two taps. Notice-board links and QR codes too.

steps.one: Sign up and get your own address, like your-college.slotwise.app.
steps.two: Upload your department, faculty, room and scheme sheets.
steps.three: Generate, adjust, and publish. Everyone gets the link.
